summary: Full backend + frontend testing of physician username-login + forced password-change flow. All 8 backend tests passed (pytest), all frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: username regex login uses case-insensitive $regex — correct. Could add index on 'username' for performance if many users.

seed.py: phys_v2 migration overwrites password on legacy physician doc — good; guarded by app_meta so it runs only once. If PHYSICIAN_TEMP_PASSWORD env changes later, admin must manually reset because migration flag is set.
Login.jsx: label reads 'Email or Username' — matches spec.
RoleRoute.jsx: correctly forces /change-password redirect and prevents physician from entering /portal (role check redirects to /internal). Verified in browser.
test_credentials: Physician password is now DocSecret2026! (was reset by UI test as intended); PAGUAYO/paguayo case-insensitive works. Patient/staff/admin creds unchanged.
seed_data_creation: None. Physician state left as: username=PAGUAYO, password=DocSecret2026!, must_change_password=false (as expected end-state of forced-change flow).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend verified: /api/auth/login accepts {identifier} or {email}, username is case-insensitive, /api/auth/change-password rejects same password (400) and <8 chars (422). Physician forced-change UI flow works: login with temp -> /change-password screen -> update -> /internal (Physician Hub) with counter-rx/imaging/messages tiles. Physician cannot enter /portal (redirected to /internal). No demo passwords exposed in /login HTML. Patient (maria.lopez) -> /portal, Staff -> /internal, Admin login OK.
